effects.onReveal: api.modStat(thisCard, 'barren', -1); const prevCard = api.getPrevCard(thisCard.pos); if(prevCard) { api.modStat(prevCard, 'barren', 2); } api.log(`蚁穴：自身荒芜-1，前一张卡荒芜+2`);

name: 饥馑
text: 场上所有其它明牌荒芜+2

effects.onReveal: api.getAllFaceUpCards().forEach(c => { if(c.id !== thisCard.id) { api.modStat(c, 'barren', 2); } }); api.log(`饥馑：场上其它明牌荒芜+2`);

effects.onKeep: api.modStat(thisCard, 'chaos', 1); api.log(`蜂巢：保留触发，混沌+1`);

name: 蜜饵
text: 抽取3，生成1张B9.2-蜜獾洗入牌库

effects.onReveal: api.draw(thisCard.owner, 3); api.addCardToDeck(thisCard.owner, 'B9.2'); api.log(`蜜饵：抽3张牌，并洗入一张蜜獾`);

effects.onDraw: api.discardRandom(thisCard.owner, 3); api.log(`蜜獾：被抽取，随机丢弃3张手牌`);

effects.onReveal: api.addCardToOpponentHand(thisCard.owner, 'C31'); api.log(`椛：塞给对手一张椛`);
const drawn = api.draw(thisCard.owner, 1); if(drawn && drawn.length > 0) { api.modStat(drawn[0], 'disqual', 2); } api.log(`雨季：抽1张牌，失格+2`);

name: 镜子
text: 获取前一张卡牌的属性数值

effects.onReveal: const prev = api.getPrevCard(thisCard.pos); if(prev) { thisCard.stats = Object.assign({}, prev.stats); api.log(`镜子：复制了前一张卡的属性`); }

name: 增殖
text: 获取1张此牌当前数值的复制

effects.onReveal: api.addCardToHand(thisCard.owner, thisCard.id); api.log(`增殖：获取了1张复制`);

name: 千面
text: 交换所有其它里世界明牌的混沌和随机另1属性

effects.onReveal: const others = api.getOtherInnerWorldFaceUpCards(thisCard.pos); const dims = ['barren', 'disqual', 'calamity']; others.forEach(c => { const randDim = dims[Math.floor(Math.random() * dims.length)]; const temp = c.stats.chaos; c.stats.chaos = c.stats[randDim]; c.stats[randDim] = temp; }); api.log(`千面：交换了其它里世界明牌的属性`);
